title: DECISION: GroupName newtype validated at construction
description: GroupName is a validated newtype (crates/core/src/article.rs). The only way to hold a GroupName is via GroupName::new(), which applies RFC 3977 format checks at construction. No raw String can be used where a GroupName is expected. The escape hatch (new_unchecked) is gated behind #[cfg(any(test, fuzzing))], so it cannot be called from production code. Why correct: invalid group names cannot silently propagate through the system as map keys, NNTP wire tokens, or IPLD metadata. A future contributor might suggest removing the newtype and just validating 'at the boundaries', which would allow validated data to mix with unvalidated data as strings travel between layers.
